errors.text_span: The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents layer numbers from 1 to 32, divided into four segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32.
errors.evidence: The x-axis has five segments (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32), not four as stated. Also the x-axis label in the figure does not say 'Layer'; it just shows the group labels directly.
The y-axis tick marks shown in the figure are at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The description incorrectly lists -20%, -10%, and 10% as tick marks and omits -25%.

errors.text_span: A blue line with circular markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1 and descends to a minimum value of -16% at Layer 13
errors.evidence: The figure shows two distinct lines with circular markers: a light blue (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) that dips to about -12% at Layer13-20, and a dark blue (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) that dips to about -25% at Layer13-20. The description conflates these into one 'blue' line and reports incorrect values.

The description fails to mention four distinct named lines from the legend: 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit' (yellow/orange with circle markers), 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit' (red with square markers), 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit' (light blue with circle markers), and 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit' (dark blue with square markers). Instead it invents an 'orange line with triangular markers' and only partially represents the other series.

errors.text_span: An orange line with triangular markers begins at approximately 1% at Layer 1, declines to -5% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and ends at 1% at Layer 32.
errors.evidence: The figure shows a yellow line with circle markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit), not an 'orange line with triangular markers'. Also the values described do not match what the figure shows for that series.

errors.text_span: A red line with square markers begins at approximately -1% at Layer 1, declines to -6% at Layer 13, rises to 1% at Layer 21, and terminates at 1% at Layer 32.
errors.evidence: The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, not -1%, and dips to about -4.5% at Layer13-20, not -6%. The description's numerical values are inaccurate.

The gray dashed line in the figure is explicitly labeled 'Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit' in the legend, not simply '0%'. The description later mentions 'a gray dashed line represents a baseline' but the first mention fails to identify it correctly, and neither mention connects it to the labeled baseline.

The description fails to report that the dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) dips to approximately -25% at Layer13-20, which is the most dramatic feature of the chart. Instead it reports only -16% for a 'blue' line.
